style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial premium tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dark graphite background #2E3238, light grey panel #F4F5F7, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and safety yellow accent #FFD100; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with small safety-yellow capsule labels; dark studio walls alternating with light grey info panels with a yellow-black hazard stripe divider motif; directional soft studio key light from upper left with rim fill and soft contact shadows; thin white line icons with yellow accents; product shown with accurate steel jaws and yellow-black dipped handles at stable scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
